entry.title: AI Adoption Is Finally Showing Up in Fundamentals
entry.summary: Michelle Weaver, head of US thematic research at Morgan Stanley, says companies are beginning to see measurable benefits from AI as adoption moves from experimentation into production. About 25% of S&P 500 companies are now quantifying benefits from AI, up from 14% a year ago, with AI adopters also seeing relative forward margin expansion. “You’re starting to see this come into the fundamentals.”

entry.title: Aliko Dangote's Daughters Join Succession Plan
entry.summary: As Aliko Dangote prepares for Africa's largest IPO, he is breaking tradition by bringing his three daughters into the group's succession plan. Mariya, Halima, and Fatima have spent more than ten years working quietly behind the scenes of their father's multi-billion dollar conglomerate, which spans industries from cement and sugar to fertilizer and refined crude. The Department of Defense blacklisted the company in retaliation for its public criticism of government AI policy.
